minefun-io.title: MineFun.io - Free Online Adventure Game
minefun-io.description: MineFun.io is an online game that takes you into a vibrant block world full of adventure! Start with the parkour mode, where you can test your skills by jumping, running, and dodging obstacles on tricky platforms. Choose from a variety of cool maps, from island resorts to the classic Obby world. Earn coins to get awesome skins and personalize your character. Want to play with friends? Join private rooms or share your room code to play together. Ready for some fun?
